title: Quasi-coherence of the Koszul normal determinant
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a Koszul-regular closed immersion into a Noetherian scheme, with r a locally constant natural-valued function equal to the conormal stalk finrank. The derived object of the explicit locallyRankedExteriorComplex of the dual conormal and r has quasi-coherent cohomology in every degree. The scheme, closed immersion, Koszul-regular sequence, ideal sheaf, pullback, derived category, direct image, internal sheaf Hom, rank-stratified complex and stalk are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pur-sheaf-hom], [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].

proof.text: On each affine neighbourhood along Z, put B=A/I. Koszul-regularity gives vanishing of first Koszul homology. If a linear combination of the generators lies in I squared, subtract products of generators to obtain a Koszul cycle. It is a boundary, whose coefficients are in I; therefore the generator classes form a B-basis of I/I squared. Thus the conormal and its dual are finite locally free, and the stalk-rank hypothesis identifies the local rank with r. On the clopen rank-n stratum its top exterior power is locally free of rank one. Extension by zero along a clopen inclusion is locally that sheaf or zero and remains quasi-coherent. The rank-stratified exterior complex has zero differentials, so each cohomology sheaf is the corresponding quasi-coherent term; localization Q preserves these cohomology sheaves. This also handles negative degrees, rank zero and the empty scheme.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_dualizing_property {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wZ} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules))) :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z ((DerivedCategory.Q (C :=
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorComplex
          (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
            (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r))
